# exo_recipient_permission (Resource)

Manages one trustee's SendAs permission on a recipient, e.g. a shared mailbox. Create runs Add-RecipientPermission, destroy runs Remove-RecipientPermission, and read uses Get-RecipientPermission -Trustee, ignoring inherited, deny and NT AUTHORITY\SELF entries. Import with `<identity>/<trustee>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exo_recipient_permission" "support_alice" {
  identity = "support@contoso.com"
  trustee  = "alice@contoso.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) The recipient (-Identity). Changing it forces replacement.
- `trustee` (String) The user or group granted the permission (-Trustee). Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `access_rights` (Set of String) Maps to -AccessRights. The only allowed value is SendAs, the default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<identity>/<trustee>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is <identity>/<trustee>.
terraform import exo_recipient_permission.support_alice support@contoso.com/alice@contoso.com
```
